summary: Depth 20 on an NSE equity, which the web's capability registry offers on NSE and NFO: today the desktop acknowledges depth 5, subscribes 1502 as for depth 5, and sends five of the 1502 event's twenty levels (audit FB-06).

notes: The web answers this subscribe with actual_depth 20 (its registry lists NSE [5, 20]) and publishes every level the event carries, up to 20; the desktop's XTS capability is depth_levels [5] (families/xts/mod.rs capabilities), so it names 5 (feed::dialect, DepthAck::Fallback) and cuts the book to 5.
Both send the same 1502 subscription for depth 5 and 20; whether XTS really sends 20 levels needs a live capture.

deviations.reason: XTS sent average_price in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode.

Depth 20 on NSE: the web's registry offers 20 levels there, acknowledges 20 and publishes every level the 1502 event carries (up to 20); the desktop's XTS capability is depth_levels [5], so it acknowledges 5 and cuts the book to five (audit FB-06).
deviations.ref: audit FB-06; families/xts/mod.rs capabilities; fivepaisaxts_mapping.py CapabilityRegistry

An XTS 1502 event carries no LowerCircuitLimit; the web sends lower_circuit 0 for it (message.get('LowerCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out.

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST); feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it (1794199530000).

This web adapter puts the mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's entry in lane wire's per-broker dialect switch.

This web adapter sends OI as oi only; the desktop sends open_interest beside it. open_interest follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed in phase B by the broker's dialect entry.
